ARES Scholarships in Belgium for Developing Countries

Last updated: 24 Aug 2026 |

CUD ARES

Masters Degree/Training

Deadline:

18 Sept 2026 (annual)

Study in:  Belgium

Brief description:

Each year, ARES offers the chance to pursue an advanced master’s degree in Belgium.

Host Institution(s):

Participating universities in Belgium

Level/Field(s) of study:

Eligible Masters in aquaculture, health, food technology, economics.

Scholarship value/inclusions:

Full scholarship covering tuition fees, maintenance allowance, free accommodation, insurance and travel costs to and from Belgium.

Eligibility:

Citizens and residents of Wallonia-Brussels Federation developing partner countries, incl. Pakistan.
